panels.title: Backup evidence
panels.description: Last successful all-project snapshot and dump-integrity check across the host. These do not prove a full database restore; missing evidence is not success.

panels.title: Production share of server
panels.description: Compare production projects by their use of this server. CPU share is usage divided by all host CPU cores; RAM share is container working set divided by total host RAM, not container limits. Infrastructure, staging and OS memory are excluded, so these shares do not add up to the host usage above. Missing metrics are Unknown, not zero. This is resource usage, not application health.

options.content:
{{#each data}}

{{project}}

CPU / server
{{share cpu}}
RAM / server
{{share ramShare}}
RAM used
{{memory ramUsed}}
{{/each}}
options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .project-pairs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; } .project-card { min-width: 0; padding: 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(127,127,127,.06); } .project-card h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .project-card dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 3px 6px; margin: 0; } .project-card dt, .project-card dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0; } .project-card dt { font-size: 11px; opacity: .8; } .project-card dd { font-size: 12px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .project-empty { padding: 12px; }

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Firing alerts returned by Prometheus, with full names and identifying labels. An empty result is not proof that the server is healthy. Sample alerts are explicitly marked.

options.content:
{{#each (alertRows data)}}
{{severityText severity}}{{#if demo}}Sample alert{{/if}}

{{alertTitle alertname}}

{{#each (alertDetails this)}}
{{label}}
{{value}}
{{/each}}
{{/each}}
options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .alert-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; } .alert-item { min-width: 0; padding: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); border-left: 3px solid #8e8e8e; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(127,127,127,.06); overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; } .alert-item.severity-critical, .alert-item.severity-error { border-left-color: #f2495c; } .alert-item.severity-warning { border-left-color: #ffb357; } .alert-item.severity-info { border-left-color: #5794f2; } .alert-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 12px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; opacity: .85; } .alert-sample { font-style: italic; } .alert-item h3 { margin: 4px 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; } .alert-item dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,2fr); gap: 3px 10px; margin: 0; } .alert-item dt, .alert-item dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: normal; } .alert-item dt { opacity: .7; } .alert-empty { padding: 12px; }
